snippet.title: Alisa's Grimoire // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364970/Alisas_Grimoire/

Alisa comes across a Grimoire that seals the soul of a powerful sorcerer by chance. Through its power, Alisa becomes a sorcerer and learns that the academy is actually a laboratory for magical experiments. To save her loved ones, Alisa takes on a battle against sorcerers.

Developed by 
Circle Kurasuke Warehouse
